name: wheel_uncovers_clash
ref: spec §2.5/§2.9: a Wheel may not rotate a blocker out of a clash line
note: Knotweed/2 at (4,7) blocks Rose/1 (4,5) from Jasmine/2 (4,11). A Wheel at (3,8) or (5,6) rotates it off row 4 (both legal without the Rose, verified); a Wheel at (3,6) moves it along row 4 to (4,6), which still blocks.
